{{Infobox auto}}

'''Cooked chicken''' is cooked meat. Like all meat in Matcha Flavoured, it has no [[intrinsic]]: it heals {{Value|Cooked Chicken|heals}} and has no effect.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/cooked_chicken.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
[[Raw Poultry|Raw poultry]] cooks in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]] in {{Value|Cooked Chicken|cook_time}}. The vanilla recipes are replaced, and in a [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]] it becomes [[Charred Meat|charred meat]] instead.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes {{Value|Cooked Chicken|eat_time}} and heals {{Value|Cooked Chicken|heals}}.

Cooked chicken makes [[Chicken Nugget|chicken nuggets]] and [[pupusa]]s and can top a [[Pizza|meat pizza]]. Raw poultry goes into [[Ramen Stock|ramen stock]].

=== Crafting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.12.3|Cooked from [[Raw Poultry|raw poultry]] (renamed from raw chicken). Kindling and the oven recipes are otherwise unchanged.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/cooked_chicken.json}}</ref>}}
}}

== Trivia ==
* The developer made meat plain so that players have less reason to build animal farms: "since animal flesh holds no special properties, players will be less incentivized to manufacture slaughterhouses".<ref>{{Cite video|quote=And since animal flesh holds no special properties, players will be less incentivized to manufacture slaughterhouses.}}</ref>
